data.note: Restored from the owner's hash-pinned sibling mirrors through the GitHub API; every file re-verified by SHA-256 and byte count. The DrivenData data tab is login-walled and this sandbox has no credentials, so these bytes are integrity-pinned, NOT organizer-authenticated.

frozen_rules.R1_no_upload_without_holdout: mean lift over the matched baseline >= +0.005 AND >= 3/4 folds positive, on BOTH instruments (tip and hide). Otherwise the round is recorded as failed and no weekly slot is spent.
frozen_rules.R2_independence_abandonment: if the block-level out-of-fold negative-error correlation between the two views reaches |r| >= 0.60 on a non-degenerate statistic, co-training is abandoned. A degenerate or under-powered statistic also returns allow_exchange=false (fail closed), per gems52.spatial.independence.
frozen_rules.R3_corridor: never emit inside the <= 200 m ring around a mapped catalogue trace.
frozen_rules.R4_range: values in {0,1}, all finite, single band float32, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, transform (100,0,243350,0,-100,4508550). NaN is forbidden: that is the mechanism behind the historical 'Predicted values must be in range [0,1]' rejection.
frozen_rules.R5_uniqueness: the decoded <f4 array must not equal any accessible aligned prior, and support novelty against the accessible prior union is reported.
frozen_rules.R6_not_the_union: the output must not equal the union of the two named prior files it was derived from, nor A_view union B_view; the decoded-pattern and set checks are reported either way.
frozen_rules.R7_a_only_dossier: every arm candidate carries a written geological reasoning row: View-A bands that fired, depth-to-basement and conductivity at the node, local strike, distance to nearest mapped trace, and explicit alternative explanations.
frozen_rules.R8_honest_reporting: every projection is reported with its interval and its prior; the site states the probability that the target is NOT reached.

metric_algebra.marginal_acceptance_rule: accept a pixel iff k(d) > alpha*DTI (exact reduction of c(1-aD) > aD f with c=k, f=1-k)
metric_algebra.unit: tests/test_metric.py pins the organiser's worked example; tests/test_h57.py pins the marginal rule and the along-strike spacing sums

hypotheses.name: anisotropic (along-strike) node spacing
hypotheses.layers: none new; strike from the structure tensor of the credited node cloud and from the View-A gradient field
hypotheses.signature: direction-dependent minimum separation: 4-5 px along strike, 3 px across

hypotheses.name: A-only buried-structure arm
hypotheses.layers: View A bands 1,2,3,4,5,9,11,13,14,15,16,17,18; View B bands 6,12,19 plus external LiDAR and radiometric surface proxies
hypotheses.signature: cross-validated logistic per view; emit only where View A is confident and View B abstains

hypotheses.name: antisymmetric edge coincidence
hypotheses.signature: cos2(theta_A - theta_B) -> -1 within a tile, against a rolled null

hypotheses.name: conductivity-depth paired across-strike contrast
hypotheses.prior_against: knowledge/03 N-6: six potential-field transforms at 300 m measured at AUC 0.48-0.52

authentication_limits: Every leaderboard score used anywhere in this repo is owner-reported; no organiser receipt maps a score to a filename or SHA-256.
|G| = 14,088.7 px is DEFINED by 'the <=200 m ring earns zero credit'; if the ring earns a little, |G| is a little smaller and every credit scales down with it.

The hide simulator is not a proxy for the leaderboard (knowledge/10 section 5: Spearman -0.1045, n=13), so it is used only for RELATIVE comparisons between arms measured on identical rows and identical node budgets.
No H57 output may be described as 'verified to score X'.
